paper_title: Reproduction package for the SVC-VV motion-sickness model identifiability manuscript: frozen numeric results, figure code, and a self-contained analytic layer. No server or credentials required.
readme:
# Reproduction package — Identifiability of an SVC-VV motion-sickness model from front end to accumulator

[REDACTED]

Archived snapshot: **[10.5281/zenodo.22145721](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22145721)** (v1.0.0).
The concept DOI [10.5281/zenodo.22145720](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22145720) always resolves to
the latest version.

Code and frozen numeric results behind every figure and table of the manuscript.

**Self-contained by design.** No server, no credentials, no network access, and no laboratory
toolkit. Everything the manuscript reports is bundled in `data/`, and the downstream (C2) results
can additionally be recomputed from scratch with numpy and scipy alone.

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt

python3 reproduce_c2.py                    # recompute the C2 numbers, printed beside the reported values
python3 figures_code/make_figures.py       # front-end (C1) figures  -> figures/
python3 figures_code/make_c2_figures.py    # downstream (C2) figures -> figures/
python3 figures_code/make_spine_spectrum.py
python3 figures_code/make_scenario_spectra.py
python3 figures_code/make_rescue_table.py  # the sample-size table, as LaTeX
```

## Layout

| Path | Contents |
|---|---|
| `data/` | Frozen numeric results, keyed as `<name>/<param_hash>/data.{json,npz}`. `param_hash` is the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-1 of the sorted-key JSON encoding of the parameters that produced the result. See `data/README.md` for the per-figure manifest. |
| `figures_code/` | Figure and table regeneration. `results_cache.py` reads `data/` and nothing else; `figstyle.py` holds the shared typography and colour rules. |
| `svcvv_model/analytic/` | Self-contained downstream (C2) model and analytic identifiability curves. numpy and scipy only. |
| `reproduce_c2.py` | Runs the analytic layer end to end and prints each quantity next to the value stated in the manuscript, so the chain can be checked without re-deriving it. |

Each figure is produced in a full-width and a single-column (`_v`) version; the manuscript uses the
single-column ones.

## What is not here, and why

**The real-vehicle recordings from nine participants are not included.** They are proprietary to
Hyundai Mobis Co., Ltd. and contain human-subject data, so they cannot be released publicly. They
enter the manuscript in one place only: the practical-identifiability anchoring on 27 sessions. The
quantities derived from them are bundled in `data/` (`downstream_idwall`, `downstream_variance`), so
the figures and the reported numbers remain reproducible here even though the raw recordings are not.
Requests for access to the recordings are handled by the contact named in the manuscript's data
availability statement.

**The front-end (C1) production pipeline is not included.** Generating the C1 results from raw data
requires the real recordings above and a GPU torch stack. Its outputs are bundled in `data/`
(`identif_limit`, `identif_rescue`, `sensitivity_field`, `driver_dof_profile`, `matrix_ident`,
`scenario_spectra`), which is what the figures consume.

The C1 recovery numbers are synthetic-truth diagnostics on a fixed nominal front end. They measure
what is knowable about the model, not real-vehicle sickness prediction accuracy.
